rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: Lucena position, with the black king cut off on the g-file. Your king stands in front of the pawn, and the black rook has no check from behind.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.e2: So it goes to the side and checks along your king's rank: these are side checks. Against them, the king walks to the rook and attacks it from the pawn's rank.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l1: The rook checks on b8, along the eighth rank. Note the distance: between it and the pawn there are only two files, c and d.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l2: Your king steps out of check toward the rook and stays next to the pawn. It is the only move: the rook watches d8, and the black king, f7 and f8.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l3: The rook keeps checking, now from b7. Far from your king, it cannot be captured.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l4: The king goes down to d6 and protects the pawn diagonally. On c6 or c8 it would abandon the pawn, and the rook would capture it along the seventh rank.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l5: Another side check, from b6. The rook still has room, but your king can now attack it on the next move.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l6: The king goes to c7, on the pawn's rank, and attacks the rook. It leaves the pawn for one move, but only the d-file separates them.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l7: Attacked, the rook goes to e6, behind the pawn, and closes the sixth rank. Had the king attacked from c5, it could not return to the pawn: draw.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l8: The king returns to d7: it protects the pawn and attacks the rook again. Promoting before this would not work: the rook would capture the queen on e8.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l9: Attacked again, the rook flees to a6. The king on d7 protects the pawn and the promotion square: it is time to promote.
rot.lateral.ideia.ex1.l10: The pawn promotes, and the queen on e8 is protected by the king. The king attacked the rook from the pawn's rank and gained the time to promote.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.1: Defense demonstration: now let us think from Black's side. The rook is on the a-file, with three files to the pawn: b, c and d.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.2: Side check, from a6. To get close to the rook, the white king will have to move away from the pawn.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.3: The white king heads toward the rook, as in the plan, and leaves the pawn unprotected.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.4: Another check, from a7. The rook stays out of the white king's reach.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.5: The white king attacks the rook, but now there are two files between it and the pawn, c and d, and it cannot return in time.
rot.lateral.demos.longe.6: The rook escapes the attack by capturing the pawn: draw. Back with White: with three files of distance, the plan does not work.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.1: Attack demonstration: the pawn is on d7, and the black rook checks from g7, with two files to the pawn. Watch the king's path.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.2: Your king steps out of check to e6: it protects the pawn diagonally and is one move from attacking the rook.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.3: The rook keeps giving side checks, now along the sixth rank.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.4: The king goes to f7, on the pawn's rank, and attacks the rook. From f5, the rook would go to d6 and close the way back to the pawn.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.5: Attacked, the rook leaves and goes behind the pawn, to attack it.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.6: The king returns to e7, protects the pawn and the promotion square, and attacks the rook again.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.7: The rook flees but stays on the pawn's file, to attack the queen once it appears.
rot.lateral.demos.setima.8: The pawn promotes with the square protected by the king. If the rook captures the queen, your king recaptures and stays a rook up.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.larga.1: Your king stopped protecting the pawn, and the black rook captures it: White no longer wins.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.larga.2: Keep the king next to the pawn; to attack the black rook, use only the pawn's rank.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.peao.1: The pawn was attacked and was left unprotected: the black rook captures it, and White no longer wins.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.peao.2: When the black rook attacks the pawn, protect it with the king before anything else.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.entrega.1: Your rook is within reach of the black king or rook and gets captured. Without it, the pawn does not win.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.entrega.2: Your rook cuts off the black king: leave it where it is and solve it with the king.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.corte.1: With that check, your rook stops cutting off the black king, and it gets close to the pawn: draw.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.corte.2: Your rook cuts off the black king: leave it where it is and solve it with the king.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.cedo.1: The promoted piece is unprotected, and the black rook captures it: rook against rook, draw.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.cedo.2: Promote only when your king protects the promotion square.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.menor.1: A bishop or knight is not enough: the black rook holds the draw.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.menor.2: Promote to a queen, with the promotion square protected by the king.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento0.1: That move also wins, but by a longer path.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento1.1: That move also wins, but by a longer path.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento2.1: That move also wins, but by a longer path.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento3.1: That move also wins, but by a longer path.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento4.1: That move also wins, but by a longer path.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.p: Attack: now it is your turn. The black rook gives side checks; bring the king to it, attack it from the pawn's rank and promote.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.fim: End of the chapter: your king went to the rook, attacked it from the pawn's rank, and the pawn promoted with the square protected.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento0.2: The shortest path goes through d7, next to the pawn: from there, the king goes down to the rook without abandoning it.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento1.2: The shortest path goes down to d6: the king protects the pawn and is one move from attacking the rook from e7.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento2.2: The shortest path attacks the rook now, from e7, on the pawn's rank.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento3.2: The shortest path returns to d7: the king protects the pawn and the promotion square.
rot.lateral.pratica.oitava.lento4.2: Your king already protects the promotion square: promote the pawn now.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.baixo.1: Your king attacked the rook from below. It goes behind the pawn and closes the sixth rank: the king cannot return to protect it. Draw.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.baixo.2: Attack the rook from the pawn's rank: from there, the king returns to protect it.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.coroa.1: That move gives Black time: they capture the pawn or your rook, and White no longer wins.
rot.lateral.pratica.err.coroa.2: Your king already protects the promotion square: promote the pawn now.
